editorial.last_message: Completed the C++ LAS implementation; unchanged source passes all 223 tests under LAS 2.0.4.
editorial.notes:
Completed a C++20 implementation, 261 local self-checks and sanitizer runs before voluntarily finishing. The LAS 2.0.4 result remains 223/223, matching the prior 2.0.3 score. The original generation grade was 184/219 under LAS 2.0.1. This official zero-inference regrade uses the committed 2.0.4 suite and the pinned offline Docker image. Its complete 223-node outcome mapping matches the independently validated scratch report. All 222 unchanged node outcomes match the 2.0.3 baseline; only the renamed negative is semantically replaced. The new negative declares external waveform storage while retaining internal packet data and keeps the internal bit clear; it does not duplicate the both-bits-set check. Acceptance/rejection solely for a clear deprecated internal bit remains unscored.  No remaining failed cases were observed. Full original transcript/source reviews are carried forward with their reviewer, content hash and path below. Those earlier reviews are historical evidence; their former tool-count exactness claims are superseded by the current session-based audit. Audited v2 tool calls: 32; preserved original recorded count: 31. The difference is a proven attempted tool request rejected before any canonical item; this does not change the counting definition. Input, output, cache and reasoning totals reparse exactly and remain complete; all token/cost fields and generation metadata are preserved. Regrading adds no model calls or generation cost. Original result/source/session/raw reports and previous regrade history remain unchanged. Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.
